sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can name common professions and say what my job is with X vagyok.
I can say where I work and who I work for using -ban/-ben and -nál/-nél.
I can describe my workday and working hours, including how many hours I work.
I can talk about my colleagues and boss using possessive suffixes, and introduce them.
I can talk about common work tasks and say what I have to do using kell with a personal-marked infinitive.
